governance.attested_by: pjm-107 gas-daily 2026-07-14: the pjm-105 symmetric-net keeper recipe (byte-faithful replay off its meta.json) + EXACTLY ONE measured override — the Henry Hub daily within-month gas shape (gas_daily_shape=True), solved on the G-A1-FIXED gas_daily_shape_factors: the calendar-day factors are renormalized to mean exactly 1.0 per month (fix 9037c89), so the monthly delivered gas level is byte-kept (verified <$0.001/MMBtu) and only the intra-month commodity swing rides on top. OWNER ADOPTED as the PJM keeper 2026-07-14 (superseding pjm-105-symmetric-net).
governance.note: The delta vs pjm-105 is ONE measured input flag (gas_daily_shape False->True) carried on the generic prb_overrides ScenarioConfig channel; zero fitted scalars. The mechanism was corrected this cycle (G-A1 pre-check): the shared gas_daily_shape_factors resampled the daily HH quotes onto calendar days with np.interp WITHOUT renormalizing to mean 1.0, so a convex gas-spike month overshot the monthly mean (worst Jan-2024 +$0.10/MMBtu) — a correctness bug inherent to the shared builder (live in the CAISO/MISO/NEISO/NYISO keepers), not a leg-A wiring effect; fixed (9037c89) + regression test. Rule 19: the daily shape moves only the gas commodity SRMC basis; no stacking on any existing mechanism. Rule-22 LOO is vacuous (zero free parameters). D-3 zero-forcing ablation twin registered alongside (pjm107_gas_daily-ablation). Bound (stated honestly): HH-ONLY — the Jan-2025 eastern-hub daily-BASIS blowout beyond the HH move is NOT carried; a TETCO-M3/Transco-Z5 daily-basis intake is a chartered follow-on.
governance.residuals_note: Honest fit record vs pjm-105 (same scorer): C1 16/16 PASS (grid-delivered mix unchanged in band), C2 PASS, C3a PASS (2025 DA-diag -11.4%->-10.0%, toward zero; 2023 held), C3b PASS, C4 PASS, C5a PASS, C7 holds, C8 PASS. C3c 2025 FAIL — and the model tail REDUCES 17h->6h (all Jun/Jul summer-load, zero winter). This is the CORRECT behaviour of mean-preserving daily gas: it concentrates the winter gas cost onto the few real cold-snap days and removes the baseline's flat-monthly over-pricing of typical January days, exposing that pjm-105's winter tail was substantially a flat-monthly-gas artifact. C3c is thereby CONFIRMED a reserve opportunity-cost / LP-vs-MIP representation boundary (diagnosis Part C), not an energy-stack input gap — no offer/gas lever reaches the actual 51h, and none is tuned to the residual (rules 1/11/13). Keeper on structural fidelity (rule 1/11: measured daily gas > flat-monthly estimate), not on lowest tail error.
